*** Dated five days before his twelfth birthday *** - Nuno Fernando was born 6 October 1924. *** He beat his opponent by 43 ***, and the highest in the form was 523. The totals are lower across the board than June's, which is what a shorter term looks like rather than a worse one.
*** The closest of the three: seven marks in it. *** And the form's highest, 1045, is far above his 715 - so whoever was top that term was a long way ahead of both of them.
